rationale: The Latin anchors *compensatio*, *emendatio*, *reparatio*, and *oblatio* point strongly to the sense of making amends or atonement for a wrong — a payment or act in expiation — which aligns with BÓT's well-attested legal and penitential use in OE (e.g. Leviticus guilt-offerings, Alfred's law code). This matches reparation.n.04 ("something done or paid in expiation of a wrong") far better than the generic compensation (n.01) or the post-war indemnity sense (n.02).
